intended_object: The standard left L-basis {u_σ : σ ∈ Aut_K(L)} of the crossed-product algebra (L, Aut_K(L), c) of a Galois 2-cocycle c. This is inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: The crossed product is a wrapper around coordinates `(L ≃ₐ[K] L) →₀ L`. Its L-module structure is transferred from Finsupp along `equivFinsupp`, so `equivFinsupp.linearEquiv L` is an L-linear isomorphism to the free module. `Basis.ofRepr` of that isomorphism has σ-th vector `ofFinsupp (single σ 1)`, which is exactly the symbol u_σ. Its coordinate map gives the coefficients a_σ in ∑ a_σ u_σ. The L-action agrees with left multiplication by L (`smul_def`), and the multiplication is defined through this basis so that u_σ u_τ = c(σ,τ) u_{στ}. So this is the textbook basis of the crossed product, as a free left L-module on the u_σ. It has the same generality as the crossed product itself (K a commutative semiring, L a commutative ring, indexed by all of Aut_K(L)). A search of Mathlib for crossed products found nothing, so there is no counterpart.
